

1 - Cleaning the input - Text preprocessing - start with basic things - Techniques: Tokenization (converting para to sentence, sentence to words etc), Lemmatization, Stemming; introduce Stop words

2 - Input text to Converting into Vectors - Text preprocessing 2 - Techniques: Bag Of Woods (BOW), TFIDF, Unigrams, Bigrams
( Here, Vector should be able to make sure that the context of the statement should be able to get captured )

3 - Input text to Vectors - Text Preprocessing 3 - Advanced techniques: Word2Vec, AvgWord2Vec

4 - Neural Network - RNN, LSTM, GRU, GRU RNN - Deep learning techniques - used for text related use cases - Spam classification, text summarization etc.

5 - Word Embedding - Text to vector - Text Preprocessing - Word embeddings

6 - Transformer

7 - BERT


Machine Learning - Above steps 1, 2, 3 - Using libraries NLTK, Spacy - these libraries help us to perform all tasks given on those steps 1, 2, 3

Deep Learning - Steps 4 to 7 - Using libraries TensorFlow, PyTorch

NLP eg.:
> Spelling suggestions and corrections in Gmail
> Translations
> Automatic reply suggestions

NLP applications: Hugging Face
